attempts.summary: Installed AIDE on node1 and established a full checksum-based integrity baseline covering /etc (via the Ubuntu aide-common config's catch-all Full rule plus package-specific rules). Verified detection works by modifying /etc/hosts.allow and observing AIDE report the exact MD5/SHA1/SHA256/SHA512/etc. diffs, then reverted the change and refreshed the baseline to a clean state. Confirmed the built-in dailyaidecheck.timer is enabled/active for ongoing scheduled integrity reporting. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot ID and aide.db checksum, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed the boot ID changed (proving an actual restart, not just elapsed time), and ran a fresh AIDE check post-restart showing the aide.db persisted unchanged and zero /etc entries differed (all 428 diffs were confined to volatile /var, /run, /tmp paths from the reboot itself, none in /etc).
